annotations.text:
Matched to the live console rather than designed fresh.

Field #080a0a, panel #0f1111, inputs #141717, borders #1e2323,
single accent #7cf000. Inter for copy, JetBrains Mono for identifiers.
Type sits at 10.5-15px, the same ramp the console already uses.

No glow, no pulse, no backdrop blur - all three were deliberately
stripped out of this product once already.

The reset token is shown on screen because this deployment has
no mail server. The panel says so in place rather than implying
an email went out.

In production the token goes to the officer's registered address
and this panel is replaced by an acknowledgement.
